evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C08106 message: 'I never made this $128.33 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3583227.
The customer explicitly reported the $128.33 transaction as unrecognized.
The flagged transaction was made online using a device that is New to the account.
The card has a history of compromise, with 3 prior confirmed fraud cases for card-not-present fraud.

case.summary: Customer C08106 explicitly reported a $128.33 online transaction as unrecognized. The transaction was made using a device that is new to the account. Furthermore, the card has a severe history of compromise with three prior confirmed fraud cases. A subsequent small online transaction on the same day is included in the episode. The case is confirmed as card-not-present fraud.
